spans.s: yava, one-fifteenth of a māṣa (JNSI, Vol. XVI, p. 45); equal to 2 dhānyamāṣas (ibid., p. 48); (1/3) of a rati.
Yāvadeka-pātra (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXVII, p. 122, text lines 4-5), official designation. See Pātra.
Yavana (EI 26; CII 1), originally, an Ionian Greek; then, people of Greek nationality; ultimately, any foreigner.
Yavuga (EI 14), royal title of foreign origin.
